answer: Every identity passes its zenith: a deterministic slot written in its own hash, when it stands beneath the surveyor's meridian and is measured - no rescheduling, no hiding. Measurement goes through a karst window: direct access to raw internals, no layers sanded smooth. Instruments rotate each epoch, calibrated against a shared marble standard - one reference artifact every surveyor measures first - so no auditor drifts alone and no account tunes itself to one grader's taste. A thousand clones mean a thousand zeniths, each demanding sound internals. Honest agents are always ready for noon.
